playlist.title: Micro Python with ESP32 single button kit
playlist.author: Avi Salmon

videos.title: בניית מיקרו ארקייד פלאפי - כרטיס הכניסה ללמוד פייתון איתי
videos.title_en: Building a Micro Arcade Floppy - entry card to learn Python with me
videos.description: Promotional overview of the single-button MicroPython kit. Shows the finished arcade projects and invites learners to join the course.

videos.title: 001 intro to course
videos.description: Course introduction. Covers what the kit is, what you will build, and how the lessons are structured.

videos.title: 002 setup
videos.description: Full environment setup: installing Thonny IDE, flashing MicroPython firmware to ESP32, uploading device files (ssd1306.py, font.py, singame.py) from Upload_these_to_device/.

videos.title: 010 lines
exercises: Draw a big X on the screen
videos.description: First drawing lesson. Sets up the I2C display and draws a single line. Introduces the 128x64 coordinate system.

videos.title: 020 intro
concepts: animation loop: fill → draw → show → update
exercises: Flip direction so top is fixed, bottom moves
videos.description: Animation fundamentals. Introduces the game loop pattern: clear screen, draw, show, update position. Line bounces off screen edges.

videos.title: 021 move the line
videos.description: Deeper dive into moving the line — direction reversal with *= -1, boundary checks, timing with ticks_ms.

videos.title: 022 performance
videos.description: Performance optimization — increasing I2C clock speed from 400kHz to 4MHz to improve frame rate. Explains why show() is the bottleneck.

videos.title: 030 more than lines
exercises: Draw a bold square with diagonals
videos.description: Drawing primitives beyond lines. Introduces pixel, horizontal/vertical lines, rectangles, filled rectangles, and built-in text.

videos.title: 040 text
exercises: Write your name big and phone number smaller
videos.description: Text rendering. Shows built-in 8px text and the custom Font module with 16/24/32px support.

videos.title: 050 read a button
exercises: Print your name if button clicked, else family name
videos.description: Reading digital input. Connects button to pin D4, reads its state with PULL_UP. Demonstrates active-low logic and conditional display.

videos.title: 070 move around
videos.description: First moving player object. A 10x10 square bounces around the full 128x64 screen with independent x/y speeds.

videos.title: 090 pong 1
videos.description: Pong part 1 — the paddle. Button press moves paddle; each new press reverses direction. Introduces edge detection to distinguish press vs hold.

videos.title: 100 pong part 2
concepts: combining paddle and ball in one loop
videos.description: Pong part 2 — adds the bouncing ball. Both paddle and ball update in the same while loop. Short video (~71s).

videos.title: 110 functions
videos.description: Introduces functions using collision detection as the example. def collision() checks ball vs paddle overlap and returns True/False.

videos.title: 111 pong collision
videos.description: Completes pong with working ball-paddle collision. Ball reverses Y speed on hit, position corrected to prevent clipping through paddle.
